span.span: One request per criterion block of the verifier being applied. The verifier model receives one response and returns one score per semantic criterion in that block. Mechanical criteria are computed without a request. The relation criterion is scored with the other semantic criteria. Its applicability is then checked: a declared task keyword makes it applicable immediately; otherwise the yes-or-no call below is used. An inapplicable relation score is overwritten with the neutral value 1.
Checkability question for a relation criterion (system, then user).
